answer: The velvet counter is kept in anchor and plume shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3748 identities would post 4337 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
